name: ZCode (Z.ai / Zhipu)
invoke: @waypost-<role> in the chat box, or let the agent pick it
after_install:
ZCode currently loads sub-agents from the USER directory only — copy them there:
  cp .zcode/agents/waypost-*.md ~/.zcode/agents/

skills.notes: Workspace skills at `<workspace>/.zcode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` per the FAQ; plugin skills use a flat `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` layout.

notes: Sub-agents are Markdown + frontmatter (name, description, model, thoughtLevel, tools/disallowedTools, maxTurns, injectAgentsMd). As of the current beta ZCode reads them from ~/.zcode/agents/ only — project-level is announced but not shipped — so waypost writes them in the project (where they can be committed) and prints the copy step. injectAgentsMd defaults true, so the routing block in AGENTS.md reaches it.
